consequences: No schema change in WP11. Revisit if a bench line for comments or the guard grows past a few milliseconds.
context: Review 11.3 and 11.6 allowed both only if the bench showed a need. With 50,000 records and 2,000 cards, guard p95 fell from 4.6 ms to 2.2 ms with the scan alone.
decision: Skip the partial index on approved cards (migration 0008) and the note_links table. The approved, linkTo and pinned filters run as json_extract and json_each scans.
title: Review WP11: no migration 0008 and no note_links table
